authorization.request: 用户指出 DSH Desktop 中 DSH Store 仍无法更新/安装，要求修改；此前已明确要求推送发布。本计划仅修改 Store 源码和发布记录，不写入真实 Desktop Profile。

objective: 修复 DSH Store Desktop 已安装 GitHub 插件无法更新及慢请求被过早判失败的问题。提供基于新 Catalog 完整 Commit 的更新入口（包括 Store 自身）；更新由 DSH 官方 installBundle() 执行，最终结果以 DSH 返回值和精确已安装清单核对为准。

change.updatePath: 已安装包的当前 Git 来源须与 Catalog 仓库匹配；当版本或来源 Commit 落后于 Catalog 时，显示更新操作。用户输入 UPDATE、完整包名和目标 40 位 Commit 后，调用 DSH 官方 inspect() 提示并提交精确 git+https GitHub Commit 给 installBundle()。同样允许 Store 自身 dsh-safe-plugin-manager 按此流程更新；禁止 Store 自行写 Profile 或 pnpm 文件。
change.noChangeHandling: 若 DSH 返回无变更失败，只查一次 listBundles()；仅当包名、版本、GitHub 仓库和完整来源 Commit 均与目标相同才显示已是当前版本，否则原样展示 DSH 失败或未知状态，不自动重试。
change.apiBasis: 当前官方 latest-three 为 0.2.1-rc.4、0.2.1-rc.5、0.2.2-alpha.2。0.2.2-alpha.2 公共类型/实现将 updateBundle/listVersions 限定为 registry dependency；inspect 接受 Git spec，GitHub fixed-Commit 更新走公开 installBundle(spec)，由 DSH 管理包事务。
change.timeoutHandling: 修复 withDesktopTimeout 把 90 秒时长误作错误码、所有操作仍在 12 秒超时的问题。helper 明确区分超时码和时长；Catalog/inspection 继续 12 秒，installBundle、waitForInstall、removeBundle、setBundleEnabled 使用 90 秒。install 超时进入已有 waitForInstall/单次清单核对路径，不重复提交。
change.catalog: 本 Source PR 不改 Catalog pin；源码合入取得完整 Commit 后，另建新鲜 Catalog release plan 和 CI-checked PR。
change.protectedBoundary: 不改 DSH 核心、@deepseek-ai/*、Catalog 准入规则或真实 DSH Profile。

commands.expected: all disposable Desktop install/update cases pass
REGISTRY_OK and full repository suite passes

gates: Fresh base Commit and every precondition hash must match; only the exact scope may change.
Disposable tests cover fixed-Commit updates for an older Git install, Store self-update, already-current no-op, stale confirmation, DSH refusal, and no blind retry.
All repository checks, package dry-run, typed-plan verifier, and exact-head PR CI must pass before merge.
After source merge, update Catalog pin in a separate plan and verify GitHub Raw, Pages, dsh.store, and dsh-store.cn.
Real Desktop UI/Profile acceptance remains separate; this source change never writes the user's Profile.

rollback.source: Revert only through an auditable CI-checked source PR; Catalog stays at 0.9.24 until a separate Catalog release is accepted.
rollback.desktopProfile: No real Profile mutation is included. Runtime updates use only DSH installBundle() after the user's typed confirmation; DSH owns the package operation and reports its outcome.

healthCheck: Run the typed plan check, focused disposable Desktop tests, complete npm run check, diff check, and npm pack dry-run; then wait for exact-head CI. Confirm update spec contains the Catalog's full Commit and no custom profile/package-manager write exists.

verification.desktopCompatibilityTests: passed: 30/30 disposable Desktop cases, including fixed-Commit update, Store self-update, DSH refusal, and 90-second operation deadline
